title: Non-surgical pelvic fracture treatment
description: Non-surgical pelvic fracture treatment is an outpatient procedure where your doctor treats your broken pelvic bone without surgery. Pelvic fractures range from stable breaks that heal well without surgery to complex fractures that require hospitalization and surgery. Your doctor will take X-rays to determine the fracture pattern and stability. If the fracture is stable, you'll use crutches or a walker and avoid weight-bearing or only partially bear weight as directed. You'll need bed rest initially and pain management. Ice and elevation help reduce swelling. Periodic X-rays monitor healing. Physical therapy helps restore your strength and mobility as you heal. Recovery typically takes 8-16 weeks depending on fracture severity. Your doctor will give you specific weight-bearing instructions based on your fracture type.
